pins.command: r=$(node tools/checks-vendor.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*(names itself a bundled package|any other name is not a self-reference)'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 2 ]
pins.evidence:
FAIL a package.json above the bundle that names itself a bundled package refuses (drift gate and --freshness --bundle)
  ok a package.json above the bundle with any other name is not a self-reference

pins.command: r=$(node tools/checks-vendor.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*submodule.s root is a shadow'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 1 ]
pins.evidence: FAIL a node_modules at a submodule's root is a shadow of the superproject's install

pins.command: r=$(node tools/checks-vendor.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*a git that cannot answer refuses'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 1 ]
pins.evidence: FAIL inside a git work tree, a git that cannot answer refuses instead of reading as no repo

pins.command: t=$(mktemp -d) && sed 's/for (let i = parts.length - 1; i > 0; i--)/for (let i = parts.length - 1; i > 1; i--)/' tools/checks-vendor.mjs > "$t/m.mjs" && grep -q 'i > 1; i--' "$t/m.mjs" && ! node "$t/m.mjs" --self-test > "$t/out" 2>&1; s=$?; grep -E '^  FAIL' "$t/out"; echo "mutant i > 0 -> i > 1: $([ $s -eq 0 ] && echo killed || echo SURVIVED)"; rm -rf "$t"; exit $s
